## External-source policy

**None of the datasets listed here are produced or owned by Elmer Quispe-Salazar.** This is a curated discovery directory for students and collaborators. Data remain with their original providers; users must verify the current licence, citation, access conditions, caveats, and version before use.
:::

**29 external sources · 7 domains · 21 open · 5 registration-based · 3 licensed/restricted**

Catalogue last reviewed: **2026-09-08**.

## Recommended starting points

These are practical first choices for routine fisheries, marine ecology, oceanography, spatial analysis, and teaching workflows.

- **[FAO FishStatJ](https://www.fao.org/fishery/en/statistics/software/fishstatj)** — Global catch and production trends, comparative fisheries analyses, teaching with official fisheries statistics.
- **[Global Fishing Watch](https://globalfishingwatch.org/our-apis/)** — Fishing effort, fleet dynamics, vessel behaviour, spatial pressure indicators and reproducible vessel analyses.
- **[Ocean Biodiversity Information System (OBIS)](https://obis.org/data/access/)** — Species-distribution modelling, biodiversity mapping, occurrence QC, biogeography and ecological baselines.
- **[Copernicus Marine Service](https://data.marine.copernicus.eu/products)** — SST, salinity, currents, oxygen, chlorophyll, productivity, sea level, habitat modelling and ocean diagnostics.
- **[NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP](https://coastwatch.noaa.gov/erddap/)** — SST, ocean colour, salinity, winds and reproducible R/Python subsetting without downloading full archives.
- **[Argo GDAC](https://argo.ucsd.edu/data/data-from-gdacs/)** — Vertical temperature and salinity structure, water masses, mixed-layer studies and validation of models or satellites.
- **[NOAA OISST v2.1](https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/products/optimum-interpolation-sst)** — SST anomalies, marine heatwaves, ENSO diagnostics, habitat studies and long-term environmental covariates.
- **[ERA5](https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/datasets/reanalysis-era5-single-levels)** — Wind, heat fluxes, pressure, waves, precipitation, atmospheric forcing and climate covariates.
- **[GEBCO Grid](https://www.gebco.net/data-products/gridded-bathymetry-data)** — Bathymetry, slope, spatial modelling covariates, terrain context and oceanographic map backgrounds.
- **[PRODUCE Open Data catalogue](https://www.datosabiertos.gob.pe/group/ministerio-de-la-producci%C3%B3n)** — Peruvian fisheries context, teaching datasets, public-sector indicators and reproducible national case studies.
- **[IMARPE coastal sea-surface temperature](https://www.datosabiertos.gob.pe/dataset/temperatura-superficial-del-mar-tsm-de-los-laboratorios-costeros-del-imarpe-ministerio-de-la)** — Coastal thermal variability, climatologies, anomaly studies, teaching and validation of gridded SST products.
- **[Peruvian anchoveta landings (anonymized)](https://www.datosabiertos.gob.pe/dataset/registro-innominado-de-descargas-de-anchoveta-para-consumo-humano-indirecto-ministerio-de-la)** — Landing dynamics, port-level analyses, fishery timing, teaching and reproducible Peruvian anchoveta examples.

## Access legend

- **Open** — no paid licence is required, although attribution or dataset-specific terms may still apply.
- **Registration-based** — an account, token, licence acceptance, or registered download workflow is required.
- **Licensed/restricted** — academic approval, institutional permission, or a commercial agreement is required.

## Use in teaching and collaboration

For reproducible work, record the provider, dataset or product name, version or access date, spatial and temporal subset, licence, citation, and the exact download or API query used. Do not upload restricted or licensed source data to public repositories unless the provider explicitly permits redistribution.

Detailed access and licence notes are retained in `data/registry.json`; always treat the provider's current documentation as authoritative.
